definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient is using or has been prescribed albuterol (e.g., albuterol inhaler, albuterol nebulizer) within the pretreatment medical record, typically found in the medication list or respiratory history.
definition.missing_value_rule: If albuterol use is not mentioned or is documented ambiguously, represent as null.
definition.name: albuterol_use

definition.description: The average quantity of alcoholic beverages consumed by the patient per week.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the number of alcoholic drinks consumed per week. For ranges (e.g., '1-2 drinks/week'), calculate the mean. For reports of 'no alcohol use' or 'denies alcohol', extract as 0. If described as 'occasional' without a specific number, extract the numeric value if provided in the same context (e.g., 'occasional wine, <= 2 drinks/week' = 2).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if alcohol use is not mentioned, not documented, or is too ambiguous to assign a numeric value.
definition.name: alcohol_use

definition.measurement_definition: The result of ALK mutation or rearrangement testing from the pretreatment record, identifying whether the gene is wild-type (negative) or mutated/rearranged (positive).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ALK testing was not performed or the result is not documented.
definition.name: alk_mutation_status

definition.description: Presence or absence of Anaplastic Lymphoma Kinase (ALK) gene rearrangement in tumor tissue.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the result of ALK rearrangement testing from pathology or molecular reports. Results are typically reported as 'Positive' (rearrangement detected) or 'Negative' (no rearrangement detected).
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if ALK rearrangement testing was not performed or the result is not documented.
definition.name: alk_rearrangement_status

definition.description: The patient's serum alkaline phosphatase level.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numeric value of alkaline phosphatase (ALP) reported in laboratory results, typically as part of a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP).
definition.missing_value_rule: If the alkaline phosphatase level is not documented or is ambiguous, represent as null.
definition.name: alkaline_phosphatase_level

definition.description: The baseline level of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) in the patient's serum.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) from the most recent pretreatment laboratory results, typically found within a Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP) or liver function test.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the ALT level is not documented, is listed as 'within normal limits' without a numeric value, or is otherwise ambiguous.
definition.name: alt_level

definition.description: The patient's functional ability to walk or move from one place to another.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's reported or observed ability to ambulate from the pretreatment record, specifying if they are independent, require assistance (including assistive devices), or are unable to walk.
definition.missing_value_rule: If ambulation status is not documented or is ambiguous, it is represented as null.
definition.name: ambulation_status

definition.description: The morphological classification of anemia based on the size of red blood cells.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the morphological type of anemia (microcytic, normocytic, or macrocytic) as documented in the pretreatment clinical records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no morphological classification of anemia is documented.
definition.name: anemia_type

definition.description: Whether the patient is using anticoagulant medication.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if the patient is documented as using anticoagulant medications in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if anticoagulant use is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: anticoagulant_use

definition.description: Whether the patient is using antidiabetic medications.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify the presence of antidiabetic medications (e.g., metformin, insulin, sulfonylureas, GLP-1 agonists) in the patient's medication list or clinical history within the pretreatment records.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as 'No' if no mention of antidiabetic medication use is found in the records.
definition.name: antidiabetic_use

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
